entry_checks.visa: For this sample party (US passports, short stay in Portugal / Schengen): visa exemption is typical for tourism stays under 90 days, but confirm on official US and Portuguese government pages before travel. This note is illustrative.
entry_checks.passport_validity: Schengen entry often requires a passport valid for at least three months beyond the intended departure from the area, and issued within the last ten years. Re-check the current rule. Sample only.
entry_checks.insurance: Not a legal entry requirement for this sample route, but travel medical insurance is strongly recommended. Confirm card-packaged cover and whether a top-up is needed.
entry_checks.power_adapters: Portugal uses Type C and Type F sockets, 230 V / 50 Hz. A Type C or F adapter is enough for typical US dual-voltage chargers.
